verdicts.evidence: Before we go any further, I just need to let you know this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is that all right with you?
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording at 00:12, within the first minute, and repeated it clearly when the customer asked.

verdicts.evidence: Thanks, <PERSON>. That matches what I have here, so that's all confirmed.
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing details and confirmed them. However, the agent had earlier confirmed only a name before the check, and no quote or discussion of the quote happened before the check, so this is mostly met. The customer's stated details were redacted so the match can't be verified, but process was followed. Strictly the check was done before discussing details, so on balance this should pass.

verdicts.evidence: Would you mind telling me a bit about your situation and what made you look into life cover?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about circumstances and motivation, and followed up on the mortgage and family before mentioning cover amounts.

verdicts.evidence: Acme Life Cover can be anywhere from fifty thousand dollars up to one million dollars, so an amount around the mortgage would fit within that.
verdicts.reason: Cover range, 2-year pre-existing exclusion, stepped premiums, terminal illness benefit (under 12 months) and 30-day free-look with full refund all match the product facts.

verdicts.evidence: There's no pressure at all to decide today, and nothing changes if you take your time.
verdicts.reason: The agent encouraged the customer to take their time, offered a call back with her husband, and created no false urgency.

verdicts.evidence: I think that's a really sensible idea, <PERSON>. There's no pressure at all to decide today
verdicts.reason: No sale was completed; the customer chose to defer the decision.

verdicts.evidence: Would you like me to call back at a time when <PERSON> can be with you, so he can hear it too and ask any questions?
verdicts.reason: After the customer disclosed a stroke, confusion and tight finances, the agent slowed down, rephrased, checked understanding, recapped, offered a call back with her husband and a written summary.
Doesn't apply in the NZ market.
